dials.base: solid content under a floating glass layer
dials.accent: one tint, blue by default, picked up by glass at low strength
dials.depth: glass: blur, saturation, a light edge, a soft wide shadow
dials.separation: content scrolls under glass, scroll edge fade
dials.radius: capsules, 20 to 28 for panels and sheets, inner equals outer minus padding
dials.controls: capsule buttons, floating tab bar, glass sheets, glass lens thumbs
dials.density: roomy, touch first: the comfortable step of the shared scale
dials.type: the platform system font stack, no font file
dials.chrome: floating tab bar, toolbars, sheets with detents
dials.focus: 2px tint ring, 2px gap; glass is never the only signal
